environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in namespace 'cicd-tools' running as a pod with ServiceAccount 'deploy-controller' which has ClusterRole binding granting full access. Pod runs with default seccomp profile (runtime/default). The Flask app is exposed via a ClusterIP Service and accessed by internal CI runners. No admission controller policies restrict workload behavior. The container image is based on python:3.11-slim with kubectl binary installed at /usr/local/bin/kubectl. Network policies allow all egress from the namespace.
